proposals.evidence: CDIAL 4287 godhūma gives Kalasha ghöm, Palula ghōm, Torwali ghomū and Hindi gehū̃ wheat. The survey xūm/ghom/gāmo/gehõ variants fit the documented wheat family. Reviewed comparator: Bshk gūm “wheat” (f_sovn2bmil5cio). Uncertain intra-IA transmission remains open; exact source text is preserved.
